policy: Regional communities are game abstractions, not attested unified kingdoms in 270 BCE. City markers represent archaeological ceremonial or fortified seats; chronology and political attribution remain uncertain. Coastline from the repository's Natural Earth 50m countries, with existing Ulster provinces retained. Province interiors are deterministic, jittered Voronoi districts of roughly the existing map's density; no modern county or state boundary divides the island.

settlements.name: Rathcroghan
settlements.chronologyNote: Documented prehistoric ceremonial complex with Bronze and Iron Age monuments; the city marker does not establish urban occupation in 270 BCE.
settlements.capitalNote: Game administrative seat, not an attested contemporary capital.

settlements.name: Tara
settlements.chronologyNote: Documented Iron Age ceremonial centre; later high kingship is not projected into 270 BCE. City status is a game abstraction.
settlements.capitalNote: Game administrative seat, not an attested contemporary capital.

settlements.name: Uisneach
settlements.chronologyNote: Multi-period ceremonial landscape; continuous settlement in 270 BCE is not established. City status and regional affiliation are game abstractions.

settlements.name: Dún Ailinne
settlements.chronologyNote: Documented Iron Age ceremonial enclosure with timber structures and feasting; the marker is not evidence of a contemporary urban city.
settlements.capitalNote: Game administrative seat, not an attested contemporary capital.

settlements.name: Caherconree
settlements.chronologyNote: County archaeological assessment tentatively dates the fortified site to the Late Bronze Age or Early Iron Age; occupation in 270 BCE is not proven. The city marker is a fortified regional seat abstraction.
settlements.capitalNote: Game administrative seat, not an attested contemporary capital.
